commands.note: The launcher shows its own help; `help` explains the sandbox and status commands.

Shows your own protection state: `protected`, `not protected`, `not confirmed`, or `excluded` for an account named in `enterprise.enrollment.exclude_users`; the reason says whether the machine policy still inspects its calls. An administrator's run shows the deployment.

`routing status`, `routing budgets list` and `routing explain <id>` show your own model routing decisions and budgets, read from the managed gateway; every other routing command is set in the administrator's config.
